## Details

<a id="music_t1_pattern_00"></a>
### [`music_t1_pattern_00`](../../../../src/music/music_patterns.asm#L6) `$0400`

*data*

Tune data. A pattern is a byte list: $ff ends it, $80-$fe selects instrument (byte AND $7f), other bytes start a note of two bytes. Note byte: bits 0-3 note (0 rest, 1-12 C to B), bits 4-6 octave. Duration byte: bits 0-3 index music_durations. Duration bit 6 keeps the gate on and lets a slide instrument glide into the next note. Bit 7 glides only; no pattern uses it. Pattern offsets are relative to the tune base in music_tune_bases. Tune 1 (demo, game_mode 1) runs $0400-$0602. Tune 1 pattern 0: 108 bytes, 192 ticks, played by voice 0, instrument 0.

- **Entry of:** [`$0F56-$0F5D`](../../tables.md#table_0f56)

<a id="music_t1_pattern_01"></a>
### [`music_t1_pattern_01`](../../../../src/music/music_patterns.asm#L63) `$046C`

*data*

Tune 1 pattern 1: 26 bytes, 96 ticks, played by voice 0, instrument 1.
